paragraphs: Simply Voting Inc. sells hosted online elections, described on its site as a full-service, web-based online voting tool. Established in 2003, the company presents itself as a comprehensive provider of secure, hosted online elections. The homepage describes Simply Voting Inc. as an eDemocracy provider based in Canada (Montreal).

Voters log in at a branded voting website using an authentication method chosen during setup. Each vote is encrypted and a receipt is issued to the voter, who cannot vote in the same election again. Results are tabulated at the end of the voting period and can be reviewed in the Election Manager before release. Buyers can configure an election themselves in the Election Manager, or hand the voting event to a team that runs it for them.

Telephone voting and a hybrid internet and paper ballot option are offered alongside the online system. The about page counts over 5000 organizations in 74 countries, from municipalities and universities to unions. That page also states that Simply Voting is SOC 2 Type 1 compliant. Voting website interfaces are audited against Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 accessibility requirements by AccessiBe.

quote.text: Advance democracy by powering elections people can trust.
